name: SITE_AUDIT_DEEP_CRAWL_20261104
comment: ANCHOR: SPEC §6 (operator 2026-11-04): the crawl opens detail views and follows in-page links one
level, and still never presses an action. Tests pin the label/role denylist, the weekly-rotating detail budget
(all rows on Home and top lists, 20 elsewhere), the completeness rule (a top-list card missing a technical or
the CIO thesis is P1), the structural rule that a capture root inside the repo is refused and ignored,
and the lane: Mon/Wed/Fri/Sat 06:30 ET + Sun 21:00 ET, a 48 h ceiling proven over a year, and a session rotation that covers every week.
The guarantee probes are executed, not greps: a live Approve target is refused before click, and a
symlinked page directory or an --out inside the checkout is refused before a byte is written (codex R1/R2).
